chapter_seo_title: Dao Twisted World Ch. 324: Li Huowang Fights the Water Sons in a Bloody Cave Ritual
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang finds the children but is betrayed by the elderly guardians. In a cramped cave, he fights a horde of Renxiao as their leader begins a grotesque Daoist ritual with a skull burner.
og_title: The Cave of Betrayal – A Claustrophobic Descent into Folk Horror
og_description: Li Huowang finds the lost children, but the elderly guardians side with the monsters. A ritual of bone, candle, and self-mutilation awaits.
twitter_title: The Renxiao start a ritual—with a human skull as an incense burner. Li Huowang isn’t letting that finish.
twitter_description: A blind monster performs a Daoist exorcism step. Li Huowang sacrifices fingers to stop it. The Water Sons are waking up.

lore_anchors.definition: In the Dao-Twisted World, a blind, malformed creature created from a person who lives miserably into extreme old age; its hair is long like a shell, nails curled, and it speaks only in ghost tongue, serving as a horrifying guardian or lure.
A local folk euphemism for the Renxiao in this chapter; the elderly guardians call them as protectors, implying a twisted familial relationship between the old and the monsters.
A staple food weaponized here as a flesh-dissolving projectile; in Chinese folk belief, glutinous rice is sometimes used in exorcistic practices against supernatural entities.
A human skull used as a ritual censer; a grotesque inversion of the Daoist practice of offering incense to deities, symbolizing the corruption of sacred ritual in the Dao-Twisted World.
A ritual Daoist weapon composed of old coins strung on red cord; in this chapter, Li Huowang separates the coins to form a whip-like weapon.
A sword of the “military path” that corrupts a normal user’s personality; Li Huowang uses it as a tool for self-mutilation in combat.
A red mark made with cinnabar, traditionally used in Chinese rituals to bless or seal; here, it marks children as potential offerings or ritual subjects.
